{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0366","text":"Subject: 30 min today or tomorrow? Gallo stability data

Hi Bea,

Sorry to pile on, I know you're slammed. Could you give me 30 minutes before Thursday's data package goes to the Gallo account? I'm worried about the week-6 stability results and I'd rather talk it through with you than guess.

What I want to cover:
1. The two outlier potency readings from lot 14. Should we exclude them, rerun them, or report them as-is? I have the raw plate files open.
2. Whether Paloma's revised assay protocol counts as a deviation we need to disclose. I honestly can't tell.
3. Who signs off on the summary if Nico is still out.

I can make any time after 2 today or before 11 tomorrow. I'll bring the plots.

Thanks, and sorry again,
Tariq"},{"spec_id":"spec_0367","text":"Senior Strategist Req: Pipeline Sync
Wednesday, 10:00 – 10:30am
Google Meet: meet.google.com/fcx-hire-sync

Guests: Marcus (organizer), Rosa Kariuki, Pavel Moreau, Yara Ferraro

Agenda:
- Top-of-funnel readout: sourcing metrics, InMail response rates, and agency vs. direct split (Rosa, 5 min)
- Panel calibration on the case-study rubric: are we scoring "strategic POV" consistently? (Pavel, 10 min)
- Comp band alignment for the two finalists. Need a go/no-go on stretching the band given Kessler contract ramp (Yara + Marcus, 10 min)
- Next steps / ATS hygiene (all, 5 min)

Pls drop scorecards in Greenhouse before EOD Tues so we're not reviewing live."},{"spec_id":"spec_0368","text":"Subject: Debrief: 1st AD candidates

Jada, Kemi, Delia,

Need 30 min Friday to debrief the first AD interviews. 3pm, production office conference room or dial in.

We saw three people this week. Want to land somewhere before Hector asks where we are.

Background so we're not starting from zero:

- Candidate A: strong on schedules, ran a 40-day shoot last year. Jada had concerns about how he talked about crew.
- Candidate B: less experience, but she knows the Elmfield site from a previous job. Locations matter here.
- Candidate C: solid all round. Availability is the issue. Can't start until two weeks into prep.

Please send me your written notes by Thursday night. I'll compile them so we can skim before the meeting.

Reference checks: Delia's on A and C, I've got B. Bring whatever you have.

I'll also give a quick update on the prep calendar, the revised location budget, and where the rest of the department head hires stand, since it's been a while since the four of us sat down together.

I don't expect this to be complicated. Just want everyone in the room.

Uriel"},{"spec_id":"spec_0369","text":"🚀 Pruitt Contract KICKOFF!!! Let's gooo 🎉"},{"spec_id":"spec_0370","text":"Forwarding again, since apparently half of second shift didn't see it the first time. Attendance is expected. Yes, that includes those of you who "never get the emails."
- Femi

From: Femi
To: All Staff - Summitspring Fabrication (214)
Subject: Quarterly Town Hall: Thursday 2:30–3:00pm, Bay 4

All,

Please join us Thursday from 2:30 to 3:00 in Bay 4 for the quarterly town hall. Dmitri Varga and Hector Grummond will walk through where things stand.

What we'll go over:
- Q3 output numbers (these will also be posted on the board by the time clock, as always)
- A general update on the Varga contract
- Reminder of the updated PPE policy, which was already emailed Monday
- Safety stats from Ben Szabo

There will be no Q&A this time due to timing. Send questions to your supervisor.

A few other things while I have you:
- The east lot is being repaved Thursday morning. Park in the overflow gravel lot. Please don't park in the visitor spaces again.
- Lunch Thursday is pizza in the break room at 12. It is for everyone, so take two slices, not six.
- Happy birthday to Abebe Zielinski and Callum Ishikawa this week! Card is at the front desk. Please actually sign it.

Thanks,
Femi"}]}
